SRC-354:R001.text: Release Cohort Membership: Affected source files must belong to an intended release cohort; tickets retain publication_state pending until bound.

SRC-354:R002.text: Staged Release Metadata: Staged metadata must match approved source without unstaged divergence; bulk git add is prohibited.

SRC-354:R003.text: Runtime Manifest Completeness: No unreviewed runtime files may be silently omitted from the tracked runtime manifest.

SRC-354:R004.text: Installed Hook Digest Parity: Closure provenance must match running engine generation; stale external verification records require re-resolution before publication.

SRC-354:R005.text: PATH Launcher Resolution: PATH launcher must resolve to the correct published generation in bin/saipen.

SRC-354:R006.text: Scheduled Injector Reference: Extension adapters and autoinject must reference project-local engine entries.

SRC-354:R007.text: Rollback Consistency: Engine rollback restores a consistent published generation, and external verification records fail closed.
